correctness.rationale: Independently formed all 64 distinct exact length-four descendant sets by survivor-coordinate enumeration and the 522-edge compatibility graph. Independent NetworkX maximal-clique enumeration gave 217 maximal 2-cliques, 276 maximal 3-cliques and exactly 16 maximal 4-cliques, none larger. Intersecting maxima yields 000000,111111; the other two words in every maximum have weight three. Exact descendant-set inclusion tests give three nondominant (basic) maxima; reversal and complement give seven all-optimum orbits of sizes 1,1,2,2,2,4,4 and two basic orbits. This finite exhaustive graph calculation proves precisely the bounded parameter, not any all-length assertion.
